Markets.title: Praj Industries shares rally 7% after Q1 profit more than doubles YoY
Markets.summary: Praj Industries shares rallied after its Q1FY27 net profit more than doubled year-on-year to Rs 12 crore and revenue rose 12% to Rs 716 crore. The company reported Rs 1,000 crore in order intake and ended the quarter with an order backlog of Rs 4,589 crore.

Markets.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood spots a hidden risk in Big Tech’s $165 billion AI capex race
Markets.summary: Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta spent $165 billion in Q2 on artificial intelligence capital expenditures while generating only $7 billion in free cash flow. Jefferies analyst Chris Wood warns that Big Tech's increasing reliance on cash-burning AI startups like OpenAI and Anthropic creates a hidden financial risk.

Markets.title: Sammaan Capital shares fall 4% after Q1 profit declines 27% to Rs 243 crore, revenue drops 31%
Markets.summary: Sammaan Capital's shares fell 4% after its first-quarter consolidated profit dropped 27% year-over-year to Rs 243 crore. During the same period, revenue from operations declined as the company reported an assets under management (AUM) of Rs 56,239 crore.

Markets.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks fall as liquidity tightens ahead of Unitree IPO
Markets.summary: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks fell on Friday due to tightening liquidity, weak domestic demand, and property sector weakness. The Hang Seng dropped 0.9%, while the CSI300 and Shanghai Composite declined by 0.1% and 0.2%, respectively.

Markets.title: Zetwerk files updated IPO papers with Sebi; plans to raise Rs 2,600-cr via fresh issue
Markets.summary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Business Ltd has filed updated papers for an initial public offering to raise Rs 2,600 crore through a fresh issue of shares. The company plans to use the proceeds to pay off debts and fund strategic acquisitions.

Markets.title: Sebi proposes mandatory colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities
Markets.summary: SEBI has proposed a mandatory, colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities to improve investor awareness. Issuers and online platforms will be required to display this risk tool in relevant documents.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rains in Japan kill four people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented heavy rains in Japan have killed four people and left 7,000 travelers stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport. The severe storm also cut power to more than 20,000 households.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli troops have ordered families to leave their homes in the village of Qusra. The soldiers are reportedly using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks amidst a settler siege.

Geo-Political.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: A new US report states that dozens of countries helped China route goods through lower-tariff nations. This tactic allowed China to successfully dodge the higher levies imposed by the Trump administration.

Geo-Political.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
Geo-Political.summary: Romania has temporarily shut down its only nuclear power plant because low water levels in the Danube River, caused by severe heat, prevent safe cooling. The Cernavodă facility, which generates 20 percent of the nation's electricity, is expected to remain closed for at least ten days.

Geo-Political.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
Geo-Political.summary: A US investigators' report states that an engine fan blade broke on a Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany last month. The resulting engine parts smashed a window, causing a man's head to be sucked out of the aircraft.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln have endured deployments lasting over 250 days, leading to severe food shortages and broken plumbing. These harsh conditions have severely impacted crew morale, with some service members reportedly considering jumping overboard.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: For the April-July period, merchandise exports rose 17% to $173.78 billion from a year earlier.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding future interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year, driven by a strong economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university models obsolete. He also believes that ensuring workforce employability is a greater challenge for India than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is expected to have stayed flat at 4.4%. A favorable base effect and contained underlying inflation offset broad-based increases in food prices.

India.title: Big Relief For Karur Victims As Top Court Clears Jobs By Vijay Government
India.summary: The Supreme Court has cleared the way for the Vijay government to provide jobs to the victims of the Karur incident. This ruling brings significant relief to those affected by the tragedy.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | 2 Attacks, 1 Uneasy Question For Sukhbir Badal: Have The Ghosts Of 2015 Moved On?
India.summary: Sukhbir Badal has survived two serious physical attacks at Sikh religious places in less than two years. The incidents raise questions about whether his religious penance is sufficient for political forgiveness.

India.title: After Ex-Trinamool MLA, Co-Accused Arrested For RG Kar 'Hurried Cremation'
India.summary: Somnath Dey, a Trinamool Congress councillor, remains a fugitive as the third accused in the RG Kar hurried cremation conspiracy. Authorities have arrested another co-accused individual in connection with the case following a previous arrest of an ex-Trinamool MLA.

India.title: "This Is Between Students And Me": Chief Justice On Bar Council's Order
India.summary: The Supreme Court asked the Bar Council of India to respond to its circulars regarding NALSAR University. The court also ordered that no punitive action be taken against the students or faculty members.

India.title: "We Recall The Courage": PM Modi On Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi, Amit Shah, and Yogi Adityanath paid tribute on Friday to Partition Horrors Remembrance Day. They recalled the suffering and displacement caused by the 1947 partition of India.

General.title: Farage's by-election victory won't stop questions about finances
General.summary: Nigel Farage won the Clacton by-election after triggering the contest. Despite this predictable victory, questions regarding his finances remain unanswered.

General.title: NHS service admits data breach due to pager use
General.summary: An NHS service admitted to a data breach involving the medical information of transplant patients across the UK. This sensitive data was transmitted over an unencrypted pager network.

General.title: Final day of heatwave for many before weekend cooldown
General.summary: South-east England is experiencing the final day of current heatwave conditions on Friday. Cooler weather is expected to spread across all areas by the weekend.

General.title: 'Two out of four, baby' - Hunt wins 200m as she eyes historic quadruple
General.summary: British sprinter Amy Hunt won the 200m event to claim her second gold medal of the European Championships. She is now aiming to win a total of four titles at the event in Birmingham.
